summary: M28 Phase 1: 将 reader-endpoints.ts 拆分为 4 个子模块（types/services/validation/routes），补齐剩余输入校验（personaId/dimension/focusAreas/biases/targetStyle/version labels/personaIds），保留 reader-endpoints.ts 作为 re-export shim 保护既有测试，并保护 customPersonaStore 初始化顺序。
approach: Wave 1 先扩展共享校验模块 input-validation.ts（新增 validateStringArray / validateEnum 及 Reader 专用 MAX_* 常量），Wave 2 基于新校验能力执行文件拆分并保留 shim，Wave 3 处理初始化顺序保护与 barrel 调整。

stages: protect init order and adjust barrels

design_decisions: 通用校验 helper（validateStringArray / validateEnum）放入 input-validation.ts，Reader 领域校验留在 reader-validation.ts
DIMENSION_TO_PARAM 作为单一真相源放入 reader-validation.ts
保留 reader-endpoints.ts 为纯 re-export shim 直到测试迁移完成
customPersonaStore 初始化通过 reader-services.ts 的 ready guard / getter 隐式等待

conventions: MCP endpoint 统一返回 jsonResponse

pressure_pass.notes: Highest complexity task; import-cycle risk, loadCustomPersonas preservation, and shim syntax all mitigated in implementation steps.

residual_risks: TASK-001 read_first should include type source-of-truth (mitigated: types still in reader-endpoints.ts pre-TASK-002)
TASK-002 shim purity check 'async function count == 0' could be strengthened with a secondary 'no export function/const/class' check
